decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall begin not later than three years from the date of this decision.

Reason: In order to comply with Section 91 of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990, as amended by Section 51 of the Planning and Compulsory Purchase Act 2004.

Condition : 2 - The development hereby permitted shall be carried out in accordance with the following approved plans and specifications: [Unnumbered Location Plan, 01-01 Basement existing plan, 01-02 Ground floor existing plan, 01-03 First floor existing plan, 01-04 second floor existing plan, 01-05 Roof existing plan, 02-01 Basement proposed plan, 02-02 ground floor proposed plan Rev A, 02-03 First floor proposed plan, 02-04 Second floor proposed plan, 02-05 Roof floor plan, 03.1 FRONT ELEVATION, 03.2 REAR ELEVATIONS REV A, 03.3 SIDE ELEVATIONS (B) REV A, 03.4 SIDE ELEVATIONS (D), Design and Access Statement, Flood Risk Assessment, Fire Safety Statement. Received: 22/07/2025
03.3.1 Windows Front Facade REV A, 03.3.2 Windows Side Facade REV A, 03.3.3 Windows Rear Fa�ade and 03.3.4 Heritage Window Detail. Received: 04/11/2025].
Reason: In order to ensure the development is carried out in accordance with the planning permission.

Condition : 3 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the development hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building, unless otherwise shown on the approved plans.
Reason: In order to safeguard the appearance of the area.
description: Erection of a rear extension, replacement of all existing windows, creation of two new openings (aluminum doors), and wood work to be painted white on front facade.
